critique: Three passes of three: the full-width gold Level up bar leads by size, place and saturation; the dark Heist tab, the small arrows and LV badge sit behind it.

Three fails of three: 'Skyskipper · Carrier' and 'Level 3 of 10' sit on the starfield gradient with no ink outline (word over art without an outline), and the 'NV'/'LV' tag runs over the badge edge. Same as cycle 76's finding. Fix: outline the words over the backdrop, or set them on a plate.
Three passes of three: Skyskipper is large and framed on a lit pedestal, about a third of the screen high, and reads in colour and grayscale in the toon look.

Three fails of three: 'Skyskipper · Carregador' and 'Nível 3 de 10' sit on the starfield with no outline, the 'NV' tag's dark glyphs merge into the badge, and the 200 price is a flat white figure. Fix: as at 100%, and give the price the display treatment.
Three passes of three: the gold 'Subir de nível' card is the largest, brightest and most saturated block; nothing competes with it.
Three passes of three: gold fill only on Level up and the arrows, the selected tab a gold rim on dark, green only for progress, Motion carries its chevron and label; nothing merges on the CVD sheet.

Four passes of six (samples 1 to 3 split): Level up leads by size, place and saturation for most samples. Two samples found the bar mid-gray and about half the anchor's height, with the dark ability card about twice its height and heavier in grayscale. Follow-up: give Level up more height or a larger outlined label in high contrast, or lighten the ability card.
